description: Representative Kristin Kassner’s background as a professional planner is an asset to her constituents — not something to mock or distort as Dan Kelly does. Kelly says he believes “service, civility, and accountability” belong to the Second Essex District, so why isn’t his campaign practicing them?
paid_for_by: Paid for by The Committee to Elect Kristin Kassner
title: Kassner’s Planning Background is an Asset, Not a Target — Kristin Kassner for State Representative
